verdict.rationale: Orrick ships self-service legal tools (Tech Studio form generators, health checks, policy builders) and client portals via Orrick Connect, so event-driven automation is a fair question for its digital offerings. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-definable rules that trigger actions automatically on events. The forms and questionnaires are one-off interactive generators, and the portals are described only as secure deal rooms and file sharing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
